svg.title: Refined Village Armory floor-plan proposals
svg.desc: Compact storehouse and supply yard with supported approaches, separate sentries, clear service areas, roof outlines, and canopy posts. Both use their front doors; east windows have solid sills.
svg.text: Refined floor plans · working spaces and separate supply access
A: Armory · S: sentry · P: support post
A: Armory · S: sentry · P: support post
Blue dashes: overhead roof bounds. Green dashes: open sky. Blue wall marks: windows with solid sills.
Porch and canopy posts sit outside the main routes. Rear rooms use their paired front doors.
Floors: blocks at Y=0. Open routes: air at Y=1..3. Door openings: two blocks high, with outside hinges.
Drawing checks cover the plan geometry; exact roof courses, door leaves, and native movement still need prototypes.
Pale green: working area. Gold dots: proposed lanterns. Yard cross-aisle and east passage avoid the supply area.
